Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You sweep a ring of light around your companions, its edge rising like a thin glass wall when magic strikes.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self and willing allies within 2 squares when used.
Duration
Until the start of your next turn; mark each recipient’s Stability grant when used.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Reapplying replaces your previous ward; it does not refresh a recipient’s spent Stability grant before your next turn.
Type
Signature

Each recipient gains 1 Boon to defenses against spells until the start of your next turn. During that time, each recipient gains Stability 2 for the first forced movement against them, including being struck in a collision chain. Use the highest applicable Stability, maximum 3. This grant expires after that forced movement even if a higher Stability applied; it never reduces distance a second time. This is a ward, not physical cover.

Additional rulings
